coverage_targets._note: Hackathon-relaxed targets (default 80/90/85/95 overridden per run-setup config).

predicted_coverage.basis: 16 integration tests × avg 15 LOC paths / estimated 430 LOC new code. Critical paths (parseCertificate + confirmAndWriteSkill + resolveCanonicalSkill fallback + auth seam) achieve >75% via direct invocation in every test.

normalizer_coverage_decision.justification: The CertParseResult z.preprocess normalizer's 4 branches (array, already-canonical envelope, flat-object, non-object fallback) are exercised indirectly via AC-01 (flat object → Case C), AC-02 (top-level array → Case A), AC-03 garbled (non-object → Case D rejects at inner schema), and AC-23 idempotent (canonical envelope → Case B pass-through if cacheable). Adding isolated unit tests for the preprocess lambda would duplicate path coverage already provided by the integration tests and would require mocking the Zod internals — an anti-pattern. Integration coverage is sufficient: every branch is exercised by a real scenario with a real behavioral assertion. Full rationale, branch-coverage table, and alternatives considered are in TADR-S2-03.

performance_tests_decision: Not required for SKILL-2: no direct API endpoint wiring in scope (cert transport is a thin wrapper deferred to GREEN phase); core cert-parsing logic does not touch latency-sensitive paths in this story.
